text:
Alex Gehaz Malasusa succeeded Stephen Moshi as presiding bishop of the ELCT in 2017, and I still hold that answer. The team note names Erasto Kweka or Samson Mushemba, but I don't believe either was Moshi's successor, and I haven't checked a current source to confirm. "Stefano Moshi" is taken to mean Stephen Moshi.

CONFIDENCE: 80
